title: Finite proper projection has the specified counit transpose
statement: For a finite six-functor operation datum S, a proper map f:X→Y, arbitrary bounded constructible K on X and finite-Tor bounded constructible L on Y, let U_f ⊣ R_f be the supplied adjunction, T the partial tensor, and μ the explicit comparison of [def-sf-finite-partial-pullback-tensor]. The properComponent π of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] satisfies U_f(π_{K,L}) followed by ε at T_X(K,U_f^tor L) = μ_{R_f K,L} followed by T_X(ε_K,identity). No finite Tor bound is imposed on K and no invertibility of π is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the faithful fixed coefficient coordinate functor and cancel the target tensor coordinate isomorphism. Use proper fixed realization, direct counit normalization, and pullback tensor coordinates. Naturality of the pullback coordinate comparison and the scalar projection counit identity give the first side. Target tensor naturality, cancellation of the inverse first-input comparison using counit normalization, and naturality of the scalar pullback tensor comparison give the second side. Reflect equality through faithfulness.

lean.statement:
theorem properComponent_transpose (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Y.obj.left) :
    (S.finite.pull f).map (properComponent S f K L) ≫
        (S.finite.pullDirectAdjunction f).counit.app
          (((partialTensor S X).obj K).obj ((torPull S f).obj L)) =
      (pullbackTensorComparison S f ((S.finite.direct f).obj K) L).hom ≫
        ((partialTensor S X).map
          ((S.finite.pullDirectAdjunction f).counit.app K)).app ((torPull S f).obj L)
